content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SVNIT Surat Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SVNIT Surat Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for SVNIT Surat Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) Recruitment 2026 is 18 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SVNIT Surat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) post in SVNIT Surat Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SVNIT Surat Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the SVNIT Surat Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SVNIT Surat Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) posts should not exceed 35 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) at SVNIT Surat?
faq.answer: The salary for Research Associate-I (RA-I) is Rs. 58,000/- p.m. + 20% HRA, and for Project Associate-I (PA-I) is Rs. 31,000/- p.m. + 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for SVNIT Surat Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) posts at SVNIT Surat involves an interview.

faq.question: Q7. What are the required qualifications for Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) posts?
faq.answer: For RA-I, a Ph.D. in Electronics Engineering or 3 years research/teaching/design experience after M.E./M.Tech with SCI paper is required. For PA-I, M.E./M.Tech in VLSI Design/Microelectronics/Electronics & Communication is required.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for SVNIT Surat Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply offline by downloading the application form from the official website, filling it, attaching necessary documents, and sending it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for SVNIT Surat?
faq.answer: The official website for Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (SVNIT Surat) is http://www.svnit.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these posts at SVNIT Surat?
faq.answer: The Research Associate-I (RA-I) or Project Associate-I (PA-I) posts at SVNIT Surat are of a contractual nature.
